openFindings.title: A bare staging category hint still lifts mcp-browser-use to the 0.82 task-intent floor on non-browser prompts
A real browser request written in the hub own playbook vocabulary reaches the compiled front door but never reaches the advisor
AC-002's closure evidence overstates what its own rg prints
Acceptance row AC-013 names a verification command that cannot produce the evidence the row claims, and the row is marked Met
Benchmark run index omits the newest run folder, including the run the release note cites as its evidence
leaf-scopes.json is described as per-mode but holds one mode
Neither installer enforces the operator-yes gate in code
Parent goal log still reports phase 014 as In Progress
promptNamesIdNoun accepts any generic noun as the skill name
Research lane table still offers an ungated npx -y bladebro launch
ROUTER.md Chrome DevTools keyword list has drifted from the router it documents
The admission canary corpus never exercises the declared three-mode bundle or the canonical ids
The advisor-facing keyword set is far narrower than the hub router vocabulary, so the hub is unreachable for prompts it routes correctly
The Aside capture example accepts any URL scheme, so a file:// target is opened and screenshotted as evidence
The Aside capture example session-dir containment guard does not normalize the path, so a traversal that leaves ./tmp passes a guard whose own message says it must stay under ./tmp
The Aside installer executes unverified remote code and is the only installer in the repository that does
The Bladebro pin and its four digests live twice with nothing checking the pair agrees
The Chrome DevTools install guide registers an unpinned chrome-devtools-mcp@latest fetch
The Chrome DevTools playbook recorded run is 4 PASS and 13 FAIL, and the failures are attributed to stale scenario text that was never corrected
The Chrome install guide repeats one registration block four times, which is what let one copy drift
The engine ignores the activation-root override the resolver honours
The findings registry that phase 014 D1 names was never updated to record the closures, so the record a follow-up review reads still shows every pre-014 finding active
The hub capability matrix advertises page.on(...) events as a working Aside capability, while the Aside packet documents that page.on throws on the pinned version
The hub README frontmatter carries version 1.1.3.0 while every other hub metadata file and the newest changelog entry carry 1.1.2.0
The hub ships no feature catalog while its predecessor hub and nine other skills do
The id-noun anchor accepts ordinary English nouns, so one shared word still reaches the 0.82 floor
The id-noun anchor length filter does not exclude ordinary prompt words, so the task-intent floor still lifts skills whose id noun is a common four-letter word
The live-attach MCP manual is callable with no stated operator gate
The parent spec overstates phase 005 unmet requirements
The phase-014 release note misstates all three of its out-of-domain counts
The playbook index names a superseded run as the latest
The registered Chrome manuals fetch a package on every call without the operator gate the Bladebro rule requires
The three canonical mode ids do not route to all three modes
Two goal logs still report the 014 work as in progress while every criterion is checked
Two packets carry a derived in_progress status while their docs say Complete, and AC-008 claims they agree

results.summary: no agent definition names the hub or its modes
AC-002 remains the one unevidenced row
The hub ships no feature-catalog/ (R7-P2-001). The sibling mcp-tooling catalog carries no stale browser-mode claim.

Seven case files and seven index entries, so coverage is complete. MT-H01 passes on stage two alone while the replay marks the same prompt FAIL at stage one; already recorded as R4-P1-001 and not re-raised.
Hub SKILL.md and ROUTER.md both state the own-Chrome attach rule
re-affirmed at HEAD; no reviewed file is dirty
